## Summary

Describe the improvement you want.

## Problem Statement

What problem does this solve for users, operators, or contributors?

## Proposed Direction

Describe the shape of the change you want.

## Affected Area

- [ ] Backend API / WebSocket
- [ ] Frontend app
- [ ] WebRTC / calls
- [ ] Attachments / media
- [ ] Backups / restore / PCBK
- [ ] Dashboard
- [ ] Website
- [ ] Docker / Nginx / Redis / TURN / deployment
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Developer experience / tooling

## Security / Privacy Considerations

Does this proposal affect any of the following?

- cryptography or key handling;
- signed-request authentication;
- WebSocket authentication or session rules;
- plaintext handling boundaries;
- backup format, export, or restore behavior;
- deployment trust boundaries.

If yes, explain the expected impact.

## Alternatives Considered

List any alternatives or workarounds you considered.

## Additional Context

Add mockups, examples, references, or implementation notes if they help.
